opening: In my last memory of my previous life, I lay amid a ruined battlefield. The villages I once hated were nothing but ashes.
You killed tens of thousands of ninja to avenge two people.
Do you know why this world fell?
Because people like you helped me eliminate those who could have resisted me.
He killed me. When I opened my eyes, I was back in Nameless Village, on the very day my father and younger brother were killed.
I have been reborn. This time I will not repeat my mistakes. Mother... I must find Mother first.
mother: Your father and brother are gone. You are all I have left.
I knelt before the two graves. In my previous life, this was where I chose revenge.
I know you hate the people who did this.
I once thought killing them all would end everything.
But then other children would want to kill you to avenge their fathers.
I do not want you to spend your life in hatred.
I promise. I will end this war.
chiefOpening: The seal protecting Wind Chime Hill has been broken. Fire, Water and Lightning squads are fighting there. The Nameless Beast is badly wounded.
If the beast dies, Nameless Village will have nothing left to protect it.
I do not need to defeat three armies. I only need to stop them destroying the seal.
I will teach you an art before you leave. Save the beast and return safely.
guardianSaved: I sense something very strange in your soul.
A soul that died... yet lives. Where have you returned from?
A future in which we all died.
The Nameless Beast asked no more. It gave me a glowing seal-core fragment.
This fragment resonates with abnormal seals. Use it to find what ordinary eyes cannot see.
This time, I will not let you die.
homecoming: You are home. I hear the three villages will withdraw from Nameless.
I kept my first promise. But someone is forging military orders and sabotaging the villages.
The crescent mark appeared in all three villages. I want to trace their supply routes.
In my previous life, after massacring the three great powers, I never visited many other lands. From here on, memories of the future cannot give me every answer.
Then listen to the people who travel with you.
This time, I will learn to do that.

wind: Did you not come to ask us to sign a peace treaty?
No. I came to find the truth.
Then Wind Village will help you bring that truth to others. The Wind Eagle is free; we will restore the messenger network.
An alliance survives only while its members can speak honestly to one another.
earth: The miners told us everything. We cannot recover the ore already shipped away, but we can protect those who remain.
The enemy is making weapons that use both chakra and magic.
Earth Village will provide materials and build fortifications. Take these defensive plans to the alliance.
wood: The sacred tree lives because you found another way.
Wood Village will research treatment for wounds caused by magic. The poison vessel is our first sample.
I almost destroyed what I wanted to save.
But this time you stopped and listened to us.
ice: Ice Tiger has been taken. The traitor’s ship headed for the Light–Dark island.
We will warn the other villages. Bring Ice Tiger home.
light: You freed Golden Eagle, our chief and our guards.
We will support your assault on Dark Village.
dark: The island and four beasts are free. We will send warnings and help the alliance prepare its defenses.
The ritual continues. We must return to Nameless now.

water: I will withdraw from Nameless Village. But do not imagine one victory will make me trust Fire Village.
I am not asking you to trust them. I am asking you to stop killing people who have nothing to do with this war.
fire: I lost. Fire troops will leave Nameless.
I will leave Fire Village. Not because I was expelled, but because I want the truth about those who died under forged orders.
lightning: You defeated three village chiefs. If tomorrow you decide to rule all three villages, who can stop you?
If he becomes the person he opposes today, I will draw my blade myself.
I hope you keep that promise.
Then let us sign. Lightning troops will not occupy Nameless Village.

water.title: Poisoned Water and the Hidden Base
water.speaker: Moc An

stages.title: A Plea at the Wharf
stages.body: Moc An found a sedative in the relief water. The villagers blame Fire Village. Inspect the shipment and its seal.

stages.title: The Flag on the Culprit's Coat
stages.body: The cargo seal was forged. The carriers impersonated Fire ninja; the purple thread and crescent mark do not belong to the village stores.

stages.title: Stop the Poisoned Water
stages.body: A pipe from the warehouse is sending poisoned water to the wharf. Preserve the clean water supply.

choices.label: Close the warehouse pipe; preserve clean water
Flush everything toward the homes
choices.feedback: Block the contaminated source first. Do not send poison toward people's homes.

stages.title: The Witness at the Wharf
stages.body: Moc An agrees to testify. Bring the forged seal and her testimony to Hai Chau.

stages.title: Evidence Before Hai Chau
stages.body: Hai Chau refuses an immediate ceasefire. He asks you to investigate the missing Water ninja.
script: You want me to believe Fire Village was not behind the poisoning?
I want you to look at the evidence rather than the flag on the culprit's coat.
Do you think I have never tried trusting Fire Village?
I do not know what you have endured. But if the war continues, the people saved today will be fleeing again tomorrow.
Investigate the base where my ninja vanished. Then we will speak again.

stages.title: The Core Resonates
stages.body: The Nameless fragment trembles beside a chakra conduit. Sense the abnormal seal to locate the secret base.

stages.title: The Chakra Extraction Base
stages.body: The missing ninja are bound to a chakra-draining machine. Defeat its guards, destroy the energy conduit and free them.

stages.title: A Machine Absent from Memory
stages.body: The captives are free. This machine uses energy absent from your previous-life memories. Hai Chau accepts a duel with withdrawal at stake.
script: This machine... I never saw it in my previous life.
If you win, I will withdraw from Nameless Village. But one victory will not make me trust Fire Village.
I only ask that you stop killing people who have nothing to do with this war.

stages.title: A Foster Mother's Request
stages.body: Madam Hong asks you to rescue her foster daughter Ha Ly, an intelligence ninja betrayed by her superior after discovering forged military orders. She is wounded in the military prison.
stages.speaker: Madam Hong

stages.title: Break the Prison Lock
stages.body: Two Blackcoat jailers hold the key. Ha Ly is bound and cannot stand. Defeat both to free her.
script: Who are you? Why are you saving me?
Madam Hong asked me to find you.
My mother? Is she safe?
She is waiting for you to come home.
Then leave. They will be back.
What about you?
I am too badly hurt. You cannot carry me out.
I promised to bring you home.
You would die for a promise to a stranger?
I once failed to keep promises more important than this.

stages.title: Crimson Lotus for Ha Ly
stages.body: Ha Ly is unbound but cannot leave. Pick Crimson Lotus on the Ashen Cliff, ask healer Dan to prepare medicine, then return to treat her.

stages.title: A Companion on the Road
stages.body: Ha Ly recovers, reveals her intelligence background and chooses to investigate those who betrayed her.
script: My real name is Ha Ly. I served in Fire Village's secret intelligence unit. My superior imprisoned me when I tried to expose forged orders.
That name brought back a memory: the female ninja I killed during the massacre of Fire Village in my previous life. Back then, I saw her only for an instant in combat.
I will come with you.
I do not need a bodyguard.
Who said I would protect you? You know how to fight. I know how to find those hiding in the shadows.
... Then let us go together.

stages.title: The General and the Forged Orders
stages.body: Ha Ly compares the letter's cipher with intelligence records and identifies the general who betrayed her. Defeat his squad and seize the forged orders.

stages.title: Standing with the Abandoned
stages.body: The forged orders are exposed. Xich Nham still refuses to withdraw and strips Ha Ly of her Fire ninja status.
script: You think a few traitors caused this war?
No. But they caused hundreds of deaths in battles that never needed to happen.
Ha Ly, you side with an outsider?
I stand with the people we abandoned.
You are no longer a ninja of Fire Village!
If you wish to punish someone, punish me.
What gives you the right to answer for her?
Then fight me.

stages.title: The Plan to Occupy Nameless
stages.body: Tu Khang finds troop orders amid sabotage at the lightning relay. Ha Ly realizes the operation aims to occupy Nameless Village.
script: All these supply markers lead to your home.
They are not preparing to withdraw. They are preparing an occupation.

stages.title: Preserve the Plans
stages.body: Compare the ciphers to distinguish crescent forgeries from Chan Thien's own plan to unite the villages.

choices.label: Keep both the orders and altered ciphers as evidence
Destroy everything before investigating
choices.feedback: Ha Ly stops your hand: destroying evidence would hide who gave the orders.

stages.title: One World, One Commander
stages.body: Chan Thien believes conquest will end war. Ha Ly challenges the price of that peace.
script: You want peace. So do I.
But you want to rule everyone.
A world with one commander will have no wars between villages.
And those who reject your orders?
They will be eliminated.
That is not peace. It is war in which no one has the strength left to resist.

stages.title: Challenge Chan Thien
stages.body: Pass the two sentries and face Chan Thien to stop the occupation. Return after victory to negotiate a ceasefire.

stages.title: The Missing Informant
stages.body: The contact who reported on the crescent organization has vanished. Thanh Vu says dispatches describing secret transport routes were stolen.
script: Those letters contain the secret supply routes.
If stolen, they could reveal every supply convoy's route.
They want to sever communications between villages.
No. I think they want to control what the villages are allowed to know.

stages.title: Altered Messages
stages.body: Recover the dispatches and compare Thanh Vu's ciphers. Forgeries order mobilization and claim the treaty has been broken.

choices.label: Compare ciphers; keep genuine and forged letters
Immediately deliver the broken-treaty warning
choices.feedback: Ha Ly spots an incorrect cipher. Delivering it would help the enemy create more conflict.

stages.title: Pursue the False Courier
stages.body: The letter thief flees toward the wind tower. Stop him and recover the supply routes and beast-control seal.

stages.title: The Enslaved Wind Eagle
stages.body: The seal-core detects a magical seal controlling the Wind Eagle. Defeat it to break the seal and free the beast.

stages.title: Restore the Communication Routes
stages.body: The Wind Eagle is free. Bring the genuine letters and ciphers to the chief to build the alliance's communication network.

stages.title: Knocking from the Chakra Mine
stages.body: Son calls for help: miners are trapped below. Reinforce the entrance before clearing rocks to prevent another collapse.

choices.label: Brace the cracked column and support the roof
Break the entrance boulder immediately
choices.feedback: Debris falls. Support the roof before opening the passage.

stages.title: Pull the Survivors Free
stages.body: Pass a rope through the rocks and pull out the survivors. Ha Ly discovers strange crystals in the remaining explosives.

stages.title: A Crystal from Another World
stages.body: The core resonates with magical crystals. Ha Ly notices you recognize something no ninja has recorded before.
script: This is no ordinary explosive.
Have you seen it before?
Never.
I have.
Where?
Are you hiding things from me again?

stages.title: Ore That Absorbs Both Powers
stages.body: A base beneath the mine extracts ore that absorbs chakra and magic. Defeat the miners' captors and destroy the weapons operation.

stages.title: The Shipment Already Left
stages.body: The base is destroyed, but some ore has already been shipped. Bring the weapons records and testimony to the Earth chief. After organizing defenses, he and Mountain Tortoise will offer a final friendly trial before you leave the continent and sail to the islands.

stages.title: The Ancient Tree Is Dying
stages.body: The central tree bearing the treehouse is poisoned. Meet Linh Chi at its roots; the core fragment reveals mana eroding its chakra. The eight-village tournament is being held at the school.

stages.title: Two Paths to Save the Tree
stages.body: Ha Ly stops you from cutting the roots. She and Linh Chi will seek another cure while you enter the school tournament and learn about sealing techniques. Win or be eliminated, meet Ha Ly and the Wood chief in the treehouse afterward.
script: Destroying the infected roots would kill the tree.
Without it, the whole forest will die.
I want you to stop thinking you alone know what is right!
In my previous life, I also claimed I had no choice to justify massacres.
Linh Chi and I will find a way to separate the poison. Enter the tournament at the school. Win or be eliminated, return to the treehouse. The chief and I will wait there.

choices.label: Trust Ha Ly and register for the school tournament
Cut the roots anyway
choices.feedback: Ha Ly blocks your blade. Let her and Linh Chi find another method.

stages.title: A Reunion in the Treehouse
stages.body: Your tournament run has ended. Ha Ly is waiting in the small room on the ancient tree with the Wood chief. She and Linh Chi found a vessel that isolates corrosive mana while preserving living roots.
script: You are back. Linh Chi and I found a way.
This vessel has an isolation seal. It draws in corrosive mana without absorbing the living chakra of the tree.
Hold the seal boundary steady with your core fragment. Linh Chi and I will transfer the poison and seal the vessel. No roots need to be cut.
I nearly killed what I wanted to save. Thank you for stopping me.
Next time, give us a chance to choose together.

choices.label: Return to the roots with Ha Ly and heal the tree

stages.speaker: Wood Village Chief

stages.title: Preserving the Living Roots
stages.body: Return to the roots of the tree bearing the treehouse. Stabilize the core while Ha Ly and Linh Chi transfer and seal the poison. Then meet the chief in the treehouse to establish a center for treating mana injuries.

choices.label: Stabilize the seal, isolate the poison and save the tree
Pour the poison into the water
choices.feedback: Seal the vessel. Dumping poison into the water would infect the forest again.

script: The core is stable. Linh Chi, begin the transfer!
Purple veins withdraw from the roots into the sealed vessel. The canopy turns green and new shoots appear.
I could not have done this alone.

stages.title: A Child in the Blizzard
stages.body: Tuyet Nghi asks you to find her missing son. Small footprints lead to the pines; heavy drag marks on the lake belong to an attacked caravan.

choices.label: Follow the small footprints toward the pines
Follow drag marks onto thin ice
choices.feedback: Fresh ice cracks underfoot. Those marks do not belong to the child.

stages.title: The Survivors
stages.body: You find the child, a wounded traveler and a girl using spells to keep them warm. She does not use chakra.

stages.title: Lower Your Blade
stages.body: Recognizing magic, you draw your sword. Ha Ly shields the girl and demands you distinguish a refugee from an invader.
script: Stop! I am not your enemy!
Where are you from?
I... I cannot say.
You came from beyond the gate, didn't you?
What gate?
Stay away from her. You do not understand how dangerous they are!
Then explain it to me!
If you want to kill her, you must go through me first.
Ha Ly...
You said you did not want to kill out of hatred. Why would you kill someone merely for the power she uses?

choices.label: Lower the sword and listen to the girl
Treat everyone using magic as an enemy
choices.feedback: Ha Ly will not move. Someone's power is not enough to condemn them.

stages.title: An Invasion Is Being Prepared
stages.body: The girl reveals that the magical world is preparing an invasion. Many opponents fled to the ninja world. Bring the survivors home and warn the chief.
script: Those who want to conquer your world also took our homes. Not everyone who uses magic wants this war.
I almost repeated my mistake.
Then remember the faces of the people you saved today.

stages.title: A Welcome in the Snowstorm
stages.body: Bring the survivors to the Ice chief. As the group prepares to leave, an alarm announces that unknown ninja are capturing Ice Tiger.
script: Thank you for bringing the child and merchants home. Refugees will be protected here.
Alarm! Ice Tiger is under attack! They are dragging the beast toward the coast!
Ha Ly, we must go now!
stages.speaker: Ice Village Chief

stages.title: Tracks Across the Snow
stages.body: Follow the seal traces and drag marks to the coast. The captors wear Crescent insignia.

stages.title: Stop the Beast Hunters
stages.body: Defeat the Crescent troops on the coast to reach Ice Tiger.

stages.title: The Traitor on the Ship
stages.body: Despite defeating the troops, a senior Ice ninja seals Ice Tiger and takes it aboard a ship for the Light–Dark island. Winning the battle did not stop the abduction.
script: That insignia... he serves in the Ice Village defense force!
Stand back. Ice Tiger will serve a new order.
Seals tighten around the beast. The ship departs before we can reach it.
Crescent now captures beasts openly... In my memories, they were never this extreme.
Then stop guessing their next move. Follow the evidence we have.

stages.title: Pursue Them to the Light–Dark Island
stages.body: Report the traitor to the Ice chief. The kidnappers sail toward the island shared by Light and Dark Villages. Prepare to follow and rescue Ice Tiger.

stages.title: The Island Has Fallen
stages.body: Crescent occupies Light and Dark Villages. Enemy troops hold gates, roads and defensive positions; the real guards have been disarmed and imprisoned.

stages.title: Those Behind Bars
stages.body: Locate the military prison. The Light chief and loyal guards are held there. Shipping records list four captured beasts: Forest Stag, Ice Tiger, Golden Eagle and Shadow Wolf.

stages.title: The Outer Defensive Line
stages.body: Defeat the troops guarding Light Village center. Its deputy commander has implanted Golden Eagle within his body.

stages.title: Crescent Deputy Commander — Light
stages.body: Enter the occupied council hall. Defeat the human deputy and his Golden Eagle form to break the control seal and liberate the village.
script: Golden Eagle is my power now. You cannot reclaim this island.
I will break the seal and free your prisoners.
The beast is inside his body. Defeat both forms to sever their bond!

stages.title: Open the Prison
stages.body: Golden Eagle is free. Open the prison and bring back the Light chief and loyal guards. They reclaim the liberated posts.

stages.title: The Real Stronghold Is in Dark Village
stages.body: Meet the Light chief in the council hall. The Wood and Ice traitors hold Forest Stag and Ice Tiger. The Gate Opener is conducting a secret ritual with the three remaining beasts in Dark Village.
script: The coup was prepared long ago. They attacked both villages at once, imprisoned the chiefs and guards, and seized the beasts.
Light Village is only the outer line. Their elite forces and main base are in Dark Village.
Two traitors from Wood and Ice were promoted to deputy commanders. They hold Forest Stag and Ice Tiger. The Gate Opener holds Shadow Wolf.
Then we must defeat both deputies before reaching the center.
I will rally the guards you rescued to support you.
stages.speaker: Light Village Chief

stages.title: Crescent Fortress
stages.body: Dark Village has become a fortress. Elite ninja guard its entrances; the chief and loyal guards remain imprisoned. Advance with Ha Ly and Light reinforcements.

stages.title: Break Through the Elite Line
stages.body: Defeat the elite troops and trace the seals locking the center.

stages.title: The Wood Village Traitor
stages.body: This deputy leaked Wood secrets and helped poison the ancient tree. He holds Forest Stag inside his body. Defeat his human and beast forms to free it.
script: I gave Wood Village secrets to Crescent. The ancient tree was only the beginning.
You helped poison the tree!
Release Forest Stag. Your debt to the people of Wood ends here.

stages.title: Forest Stag Is Free
stages.body: Sever the deputy’s remaining bond and remove Forest Stag from the seal formation. One layer has fallen; the Ice traitor holds the next route.

stages.title: The Ice Village Traitor
stages.body: Face the ninja who stole Ice Tiger on the coast. He once held a senior defense post in Ice Village. Defeat both forms to rescue Ice Tiger.
script: It is him! The ninja who took Ice Tiger aboard the ship.
I chose the winning side. Ice Village has no claim on me anymore.
You betrayed those you were meant to protect. I will bring Ice Tiger home.

stages.title: Two Locks Have Fallen
stages.body: Ice Tiger is free. Break the final seal conduit with Ha Ly and open the route to the deepest ritual chamber.

stages.title: The Gate Opener
stages.body: Both deputies have fallen. Defeat the Gate Opener through three phases, using the original human, Shadow Wolf and combined Dark guardian battle.
script: You passed both deputies. But the final gate remains in my hands.
I will bring Shadow Wolf and your prisoners out.
We will end the occupation of this island together.

stages.title: The Last Beast Is Rescued
stages.body: Break Shadow Wolf’s control seal. The Dark chief and loyal guards are freed, ending Crescent control. The defeated Gate Opener still has something to reveal.

stages.title: The Ritual Does Not Stop
stages.body: Only after defeat does the Gate Opener reveal his plan: force four beasts to power the destruction of the seal between the worlds. The ritual has started; his defeat cannot erase its stored energy.
script: I do not need to rule a few villages. I need the power keeping the worlds apart.
Each beast sustains part of the balance. My seals force that power into energy to open the gate.
Wood, Ice, Light and Dark lie near key ocean seals. Their four beasts are the keys.
The Fire, Water and Lightning war was meant to weaken you. Your truce and alliance forced me to accelerate the captures.
The beasts are free. Your ritual is over.
Stored energy does not vanish with my defeat. The ritual has begun. The gate will open soon.
We must return to Nameless and warn the alliance now!

stages.title: A Warning from the Liberated Island
stages.body: Meet Vo Nguyet to evacuate prisoners and beasts. Dark and Light Villages relay the warning. Return to Nameless with Ha Ly before the gate opens.
stages.speaker: Vo Nguyet

stages.title: Warn the Alliance
stages.body: Return to Wind Chime Hill with Ha Ly. The Gate Opener is defeated, but the ritual continues. Nine villages hurry to complete their defenses.
script: The four beasts are rescued, but the ritual’s stored energy is still breaking the seals.
The vanguard could arrive at any moment. Warn every village.

stages.title: The Gate in the Sky
stages.body: Ancient seals light up as a giant gate appears overhead. Nine villages and the rescued beasts rally to defend the ninja world.
script: This time the villages stand together.
Lightning is ready.
Fire will hold the line.
Water will protect those behind us.
Wind, Earth, Wood, Ice, Light and Dark take their positions. Rescued beasts return to their protectors. The Nameless Beast shields the alliance.
In my previous life, I fought against the whole world. In this life... I will fight alongside it.

stages.title: The Otherworld Vanguard
stages.body: With Ha Ly, the alliance and the Nameless Beast’s barrier, stop the invasion vanguard. Those once divided now protect one another.

stages.title: A Future Defended Together
stages.body: The alliance repels the first invasion wave and holds its defenses. The island is liberated, four beasts are rescued, and the alliance has become a real force.
script: We held the line. There will be more to face together.
Then we will keep choosing together.
